name: Uniqode
description:
Uniqode is a digital experience platform used by enterprises in retail, hospitality, healthcare, and other industries to create, deploy, and analyze dynamic QR Codes, Linkpages, and related campaigns at scale. Linkpages are Uniqode's mobile-friendly link-in-bio pages — a single URL or QR code presenting a customer's social profiles, product pages, menus, or forms — with analytics on views, unique visitors, link clicks, and geographic, device, and time breakdowns.

The Uniqode MCP connector brings your Uniqode data into Claude, so users can check scan performance, engagement, and campaign results just by asking — no dashboard filters or exports needed. Users can also build custom dashboards to see the metrics that matter most at a glance.

You can get total and unique scan counts, top and bottom performing QR Codes, daily trends, and breakdowns by country, device, and time of day. You can also filter codes by tag or naming convention (e.g., codes tagged "Retail") and compare results across campaigns.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Uniqode to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Uniqode to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.uniqode.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Uniqode MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Uniqode lists 33 MCP tools, including bulk_create_qr_codes, create_qr_code, delete_qr_code, download_qr_code, edit_qr_code, filter_qr_codes, get_current_user, get_linkpage_clicks_by_link, get_linkpage_clicks_timeseries, get_linkpage_engagement, get_linkpage_view_locations, and get_linkpage_views_by_city.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Uniqode?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Uniqode in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Uniqode requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Uniqode is developed by Uniqode Phygital, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
